detail_observations.label: Description
detail_observations.text: Adaenyl says, "Even though this plateau is dry and inhospitable, it has been home to my herd for centuries. In the past, the dark elves would occasionally take a unicorn for their experiments, but never did they try to control the entire herd." "But now, the Aeokor have come. They are weak compared to the other dark elves, but numerous enough to corral us. They seek to steal our strength." "They are in the ruins to the northeast. If you slay many of them, we will be able to overwhelm the rest."

detail_observations.label: Another account
detail_observations.text:
Walkthrough as recorded by vgwalkthroughs 1. Aeokor Hunting
   Traveling to Adaenyl might seem like a pain at first, but a quick way there would be to take the Riftway to Hathor Zhi, and just use the rentable wyvern mount to fly north until you reach Adaenyl (she should be on your map as a wayward point).
   Once you get there, Adaenyl will tell you about how the Aeokor Dark Elves are enslaving their herd! Luckily they are only a small journey away to the northeast at some nice looking ruins. You must kill 45 Aeokor mobs (lvl 24 3dot) to complete the quest. Any mob at the ruins will grant you an update, but unfortunately there won't be enough mobs to complete the quest. In fact there are only 37 mobs in total in the ruins, and the respawn is around 30 minutes long, so if somebody else is doing this while you are, it might be a good idea to join up together, as you will finish this part much quicker if you do (and who knows you might gain a friend). After finishing the quest, return to Adaenyl for the next quest.
2. I need a Doctor!
   Adaenyl now needs your help to construct a Ceratescryer, which is some device that will allow the unicorns to contact each other. Apparently the Shrilien Witch Doctors have constructed 3 different shamanic devices that if combined into the Ceratescryer, it'll make the device work.
   So make your way to the Skrilien Camp (the one you need is marked on your map) and start killing those lizards. The Shrilien Lizardmen range from 23 - 24 2dot mobs, but they do come in groups, so watch out! You will notice that Shrilien Witch Doctors spawn throughout the whole camp, but I found that the ones located inside the huts have a slightly better chance of dropping them than the ones outside, roaming around (note: each item drops randomly for each member of your group). Once you obtain all three keys, return to Adaenyl for the turn in.
3. Raynien's Retreat
   Well now that the Ceratescryer is working, Adaenyl's unicorn sense starts tingling, and you know what happens to unicorns when their senses start tingling right? Well, I certainly don't, because the device only seems to sense some far off unicorn named Raynien in a chunk called Jalen's Retreat (which is 4 chunks to the left of where you are!). Note: he is marked on your map.
   I would recommend going to the nearest riftway and buying a wyvern mount to help speed up the travel time to Raynien. If you have levitate you may also need to use it, as Raynien is located on an island, and travel through water is neccessary to get to him. Also note that you may have to travel through a chunk called the Islands of Madness. The mobs here are lvl 35-40, and there are tons of mobs in the water (watch out when you travel through this chunk). After making it to Raynien, have a little chat with him, get the quest update, then head on out of there back to Adaenyl.
4. Brief Stop in Kojan
   When you return to Adaenyl her senses start to tingle yet again, but this time she wants to get it on with two unicorns from Kojan! I recommend porting to Sundering Wastelands and going 2 chunks south and one chunk west, and locating Grathael on the southern most island in that chunk first (it's marked on your map). After you talk to Grathael make your way 3 chunks south and 1 chunk east to Athanalor (which is also marked on your map). After that just head back to Adaenyl for the turn in, in which you will receive your choice of one of these new gloves!:
   Allegiance Scale Gauntlets
   Now because of your successful missiong to find those other unicorns, Adaenyl tells you that you must head to the east coast of Qalia to find a whole herd of unicorn and seek out their leader Medratheda, who apparently needs your help.
   Part 1 - Zar the "not-so" Mighty
   Required Level: 21The Unicorn Horn
   Part 2 - Adaenyl's Bidding

   Part 3 - Medratheda's Bidding
   Required Level: 24Let's Make Some Lizard Stew.

The fastest way there would be to take the riftway to Qa Riverbank, and head one chunk east on the back of a wyvern. Ardalan Awji is located in the mountains and should be easy to find, especially since you have a mark on your map that leads directly to him.
   When you make it to Ardalan Awji he instantly gives you a new Allegiance Saddlebag, which is a 22 slot saddlebag, and most likely will replace the one that you have on (woohoo, you can collect more junk now!).
   Quest: Question and Answer
   Ardalan Awji seems willing to fix the device for you, and says that it would be a challenge worthy of his wit. Unfortunately he needs Arcane Pliers to complete the job, but he doesn't have it to fix the device, but he does know somebody who does named Azeeta Shaheen. Now the tool costs 10 gold to get (yup GOLD!), so I hope you have a lot of cash to burn. Azeeta Shaheen is located one chunk south in the chunk of Zossyr Hakrel. Watch out for mobs as you run through this chunk as there are many mobs in the low 30s (2dot) that will attack you, but once you do make it to Azeeta Shaheen, it is just a matter of purchasing the Pliers and heading back to Ardalan Awji for the turn in.
2. The Device Works!
   Your Unicorn Teleporter is now in full working condition! All you have to do is right click the device to find the last remaining lost Unicorn. When you do right click it, a point on your map will appear on the northern portion of Thestra, of a unicorn by the name of Aynien.
   There is no easy way to travel to Aynien and the only way I can suggest would be to take the riftway to Three Rivers, and fly as far as you can go to Aynien (she is marked on your map. She is located three chunks to the north and two chunks to the west on a small island. When you get there, watch out for mobs that are also on the island.
3. The Last Unicorn
   When you make it to Aynien you inform her that you have a device that will teleport her away from this island. She is skeptical of the device and wants to examine it over before she uses it. While she is examining it she would like you to kill a few of the Seadredges and Kelpwalkers that lurk around the island, 15 Seadredges and 25 Kelpwalkers to be exact! Both mobs are around level 30 3dot and are not only wandering around the island, but are also wandering in the water. In fact there won't be enough mobs to kill on land, that you will be forced to either wait for respawn or find them in the water.
   After all 40 mobs are killed go back to Aynien where she agrees to use the Unicorn Teleporter. She has attuned the device to her and needs you to use the device on her so she can get teleported. She also tells you to return to Myrthion (the very first unicorn!) and explain to him that all the unicorns have been reunited!
   So you can right click the device on Aynien and start your long journey back to Myrthion. I recommend recalling back to civilization and taking your nearest riftway back to Silverlake. Take a Griffon from there and fly north until you reach Myrthion (he is marked on your map). You find Myrithion in the exact same place where you left him, and he is extremely excited that you have found all of the lost unicorns! In fact he is so excited that he offers you a Unicorn Mount! (FINALLY!)
   Now there will be a bunch of different Unicorns that you can choose from, each of them have the same stats and the only difference would be that they have different color saddles. Your choices of colors are Forest-Colored, Amber, Black, Sky-Colored, Green, and Blue. So pick your favorite color and there you have it, your very own Unicorn Mount! Now go gallop around the world on your glorious steed, and show off your new pet!

I believe the unicorns of Leth Verael worked with the high elves to develop and use these devices. Perhaps they'd teleport unicorns across the city to get from one garden to another. Walkthrough as recorded by vgwalkthroughs

1. The Broken Device Enorian Andowyn ends up giving you a teleportation device that is broken. He dug it up in the Leth Verael ruins a while back, and was broken when he found it. He tells you about a guy that he knows named Ardalan Awji, who lives in the mountains in Qalia, by the city of Mekalia. The fastest way there would be to take the riftway to Qa Riverbank, and head one chunk east on the back of a wyvern. Ardalan Awji is located in the mountains and should be easy to find, especially since you have a mark on your map that leads directly to him. When you make it to Ardalan Awji he instantly gives you a new Allegiance Saddlebag, which is a 22 slot saddlebag, and most likely will replace the one that you have on (woohoo, you can collect more junk now!). Quest: Question and Answer Ardalan Awji seems willing to fix the device for you, and says that it would be a challenge worthy of his wit. Unfortunately he needs Arcane Pliers to complete the job, but he doesn't have it to fix the device, but he does know somebody who does named Azeeta Shaheen. Now the tool costs 10 gold to get (yup GOLD!), so I hope you have a lot of cash to burn. Azeeta Shaheen is located one chunk south in the chunk of Zossyr Hakrel. Watch out for mobs as you run through this chunk as there are many mobs in the low 30s (2dot) that will attack you, but once you do make it to Azeeta Shaheen, it is just a matter of purchasing the Pliers and heading back to Ardalan Awji for the turn in. 2. The Device Works! Your Unicorn Teleporter is now in full working condition! All you have to do is right click the device to find the last remaining lost Unicorn. When you do right click it, a point on your map will appear on the northern portion of Thestra, of a unicorn by the name of Aynien. There is no easy way to travel to Aynien and the only way I can suggest would be to take the riftway to Three Rivers, and fly as far as you can go to Aynien (she is marked on your map. She is located three chunks to the north and two chunks to the west on a small island. When you get there, watch out for mobs that are also on the island. 3. The Last Unicorn When you make it to Aynien you inform her that you have a device that will teleport her away from this island. She is skeptical of the device and wants to examine it over before she uses it. While she is examining it she would like you to kill a few of the Seadredges and Kelpwalkers that lurk around the island, 15 Seadredges and 25 Kelpwalkers to be exact! Both mobs are around level 30 3dot and are not only wandering around the island, but are also wandering in the water. In fact there won't be enough mobs to kill on land, that you will be forced to either wait for respawn or find them in the water. After all 40 mobs are killed go back to Aynien where she agrees to use the Unicorn Teleporter. She has attuned the device to her and needs you to use the device on her so she can get teleported. She also tells you to return to Myrthion (the very first unicorn!) and explain to him that all the unicorns have been reunited! So you can right click the device on Aynien and start your long journey back to Myrthion. I recommend recalling back to civilization and taking your nearest riftway back to Silverlake. Take a Griffon from there and fly north until you reach Myrthion (he is marked on your map). You find Myrithion in the exact same place where you left him, and he is extremely excited that you have found all of the lost unicorns! In fact he is so excited that he offers you a Unicorn Mount! (FINALLY!) Now there will be a bunch of different Unicorns that you can choose from, each of them have the same stats and the only difference would be that they have different color saddles. Your choices of colors are Forest-Colored, Amber, Black, Sky-Colored, Green, and Blue. So pick your favorite color and there you have it, your very own Unicorn Mount! Now go gallop around the world on your glorious steed, and show off your new pet!
